Name: Visual Crossing Portrait Overhaul
Author: K2sync
Description:
[center][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/894b1bede00b6e791ceea51bc0202e8b/55da525e3a8f7524-33/s400x600/9405f86a075bf7c75936a38e3e11da679c219201.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://66.media.tumblr.com/32a1d929b105dde11f08331c4a101f1a/a946edea84b0d6be-70/s400x600/0785f1420cf1a6a78fe3b8b67a8a7c3a28773dfb.png[/img]﻿
﻿[/center]
An extensive overhaul of hand-drawn pixel portraits that (on the most part) use the original palettes and aspect ratio, so they feel close to the vanilla images. Comes with alternate designs to customize the people of the valley, and PSDs to make them easier to edit.

Designed to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1942]Visual Crossing Character Overhaul[/url], with equivalent styles.

If you have a suggestion for an alt or an error to report, please do!

﻿[size=5]Install
[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install ContentPatcher[/url]﻿﻿.

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][list=1]

[/list][size=5]Changing To An Alt[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open the "Config.json" file.

[*]Replace the current sprite (usually "true") with your desired item (as written in the Style guide at the top of content.json, or listed in the README.)
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Definitive version of Visual Crossing Portraits for Content Patcher.
